glosses: barbecue (fireplace or pit for grilling food)

meats (traditionally from the inside of a cow's cheek or jaw) or a whole sheep slow cooked over an open fire, or more traditionally, in a hole dug in the ground covered with maguey leaves, although the interpretation is loose
meat steamed until tender (most common present use)

examples.text: Yo también quiero tener una barbacoa.
examples.en: I also want to have a barbecue.

examples.text: Me gustan las alitas de pollo con salsa barbacoa.
examples.en: I like my chicken wings with barbeque sauce.

examples.text: Me parece bien si hacemos una barbacoa, pero no me gusta cuando el humo se mete en mis ojos.
examples.en: It's OK with me if we barbecue, but I don't like it when smoke gets in my eyes.
